rule_name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) & All Inclusive of Taxes
description: Every retail package must declare Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes clearly with statutory currency symbol (Rs. / ₹ / INR / Regional Script) and statutory tax inclusion suffix.
remediation: Ensure MRP is prominently displayed in statutory format (e.g. 'MRP Rs. 250.00 (Inclusive of all taxes)' or 'एमआरपी ₹ २५० (सभी करों सहित)')

rule_name: Net Quantity & Approved SI Metric Units
legal_act_section: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 - Rule 11 and Rule 12
description: Net quantity must be declared using standard SI metric units (g kg ml l m cm mm) or standard count numbers (N U units pcs pens). Use of non-standard or imperial units (fl oz oz lbs gallon yard inch) is strictly prohibited under Rule 11.
remediation: Declare net quantity strictly in approved SI Metric units (e.g. 'Net Qty: 500 g' or 'Net Vol: 200 ml' or 'Net Qty: 1 N'). Remove all non-metric imperial units.

description: Every package must declare complete contact details of person or office for consumer complaints including telephonic helpline or toll-free number and official email address or postal address.
remediation: Print dedicated consumer care details including contact person/cell telephonic helpline (toll-free/landline/mobile) and active email address (e.g. 'care@company.com' / 'Toll Free: 1800-XXX-XXXX')

description: Month and Year of manufacture packing or import must be clearly declared on the retail package for consumer transparency.
remediation: Print clearly the Month and Year of manufacture or packaging (e.g. 'Mfg Date: 02/2026' or 'Pkd: 01/2026' or 'Date of Mfg: 03/2026')

rule_name: Principal Display Panel & Minimum Font Height
legal_act_section: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 - Rule 9 & Schedule II
description: Declarations must be legible and meet the minimum font height standards prescribed in Schedule II based on package net quantity/weight (1.0mm to 6.0mm height).
remediation: Ensure all statutory numerals and alphabets on Principal Display Panel meet minimum font height requirements (at least 1.0mm to 4.0mm based on volume/weight)

description: Name of country of origin or manufacture must be clearly declared on every imported and domestic commodity package.
remediation: Explicitly mention 'Country of Origin: India' or originating nation on the Principal Display Panel

rule_name: Name and Address of Manufacturer / Packer / Importer
description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer packer or importer must be clearly declared on the package.
remediation: Mention full name and registered factory/office address of the manufacturer packer or marketer with PIN code
